Subject: Forecast handoff + weekly call slate

Team / Sarah —

We have our weekly forecast submission Friday, but Acme requested an earlier alignment this week so they can finalize budget signoff. I want to run a short handoff + cadence call tomorrow to align stages and the commit we're going to report into the submission.

Proposed slate (30 min):
- 09:00–09:10: Quick status: current best-case ARR, top open risks
- 09:10–09:20: Stage hygiene: confirm SFDC stage + probability per ACS account (rollups only)
- 09:20–09:30: Commit statement: what we will submit; owners & next steps

Action items before the call (please):
- Marissa: bring updated pricing / quotes for final PO (see attached acme-deal-plan.pdf)
- Karthik: map expected clinch date to our submission buckets and call out any dependency on procurement/legal
- Jordan: confirm the engineering resource handoff window if we win this quarter
- Sarah: any last-minute procurement constraints or PO templates we should expect

Attachments: Q4_forecast_template.xlsx (fill in the "submit" tab), acme-deal-plan.pdf (latest redlines).

If the time above doesn't work for Sarah, propose 09:30 or 16:00 PST and we'll adjust.

Thanks —
Logan

Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0183
